snippet.title: Copy Cats - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Get it now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4700300/Copy_Cats/
App Store:
https://apps.apple.com/app/copy-cats-puzzle-adventure/id6758952460
Google Play: 
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.adventureislands.copycats

Utilize the power of the mysterious cloning machine and use your handy copy cats to solve puzzles and help a little kitty escape from a strange virtual dimension!
